rev6.release_notes: Fusion add-in: Export tab > Export Model to G-SEND Drawing - one click sends the open design to G-SEND CAD CAM, which opens it as a new part straight into its drawing (front, top, right and iso views). Check (editor right-click) now also runs the program checks - e.g. two Z words on one line - and lists them with their line and operation.

cadcam.release_notes: Export Model to G-SEND Drawing: a model sent from the CAD add-in opens as a new part, straight into its drawing (front, top, right and iso views). Copy and paste: Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V on sketch geometry (with its rules and dimensions) and on bodies. Save while in a sketch saves the sketch and keeps you in it; Open brings you back to it. Sketch: geometry on an origin axis stays on it when a dimension changes, and a rule that is already set is shown as a reference instead of turning the sketch red.
